decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting remains a specialized niche with high uncertainty and low keeping costs, so the option is kept while long-term contract prospects are still possible.
The desk lamp is a low-cost option with a dedicated page and task-lighting appeal, so it is kept while its market potential remains uncertain.
As a core interior luminaire with updated models and alignment to the firm's main market, it has little reason to be dropped.
The flagship pendant luminaire embodies the firm's strategic direction in microprismatic optics and remains a core option, so drop risk is minimal.

The marine searchlight has only a minimal website presence, is outside the firm's core intelligent-lighting direction, and redundant capabilities after E was dropped, so the option is abandoned to free resources.
